notes.title: Cube Escape Collection - Release date + Trailer
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/7840c5679b78faccf1deb65fa216558498b198a9.jpg

Finally! The Cube Escape Collection will be released on October 14th on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6RUyC-w9Lk

Follow the path of Dale, Laura and other Rusty lake characters like Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl in this classic point-and-click adventure anthology! The nine Cube Escape games are updated (achievements / hints / translations), preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

Thanks for your support 🖤

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection

Art by Sevenix!

notes.title: Boo! Rusty Lake release Cube Escape: Paradox and short film
notes.notes:
I’m calling it: Halloween season starts now. I’ve just hung a spooky lantern in the hallway and the spooky-ooky Rusty Lake gang today released not only a new altogether kooky adventure game but a live-action short film too. Ghost time is go. Cube Escape: Paradox is out now, offering its first chapter free so we can all try on the shoes of a detective trapped in a weird room across parallel universes, and the Paradox film is free and all. It’s pretty nifty too, as transmedia crossover tie-ins go. Have a watch below:
